description: A generic scoping review extraction schema following Arksey & O'Malley (2005) and JBI methodology. Use this as a starting point for your own review, or as a reference for how ReviewForge schemas work.

fields.label: Author(s)
fields.help_text: Last name, initials. Multiple authors separated by semicolons.

fields.label: Population / Participants
fields.help_text: Who was studied? Sample size, demographics, setting.

fields.label: Context / Setting
fields.help_text: Where and when was this study conducted? What is the relevant policy, cultural, or institutional context?

fields.label: Aim / Research Question
fields.help_text: What was the study trying to find out?

fields.label: Summary of Findings
fields.help_text: Summarize the main findings relevant to your review question.

fields.label: Themes / Categories
fields.help_text: Key themes, categories, or constructs identified. List each on a new line.

fields.label: Key Quotes
fields.help_text: Direct quotes worth noting, with page numbers.

field_groups.description: How does this source relate to your review?

options.label: High: Directly addresses the review question
Moderate: Partially relevant or tangentially related
Low: Peripherally relevant, included for context

fields.label: Limitations / Notes
fields.help_text: Any limitations, biases, or methodological concerns.

fields.label: Reviewer Memo
fields.help_text: Your thoughts on this source. What stands out? How does it connect to other sources? What questions does it raise?
